Aarav Unmanned Systems Private Limited.evidence: Aarav Unmanned Systems Private Limited is an active registered legal entity in Bengaluru, India, that rebranded its commercial brand identity to Aereo in 2022. The company designs, develops, and deploys fully autonomous commercial-grade drones and aerial intelligence software solutions.

Avironix Technologies Private Limited.evidence: The company exists as Avironix Private Limited / Arivonix Technologies India Private Limited registered in Tamil Nadu, and actively manufactures indigenous agricultural and defence UAVs under the brand AvironiX Drones using its official site avironix.com according to business registries and press releases.

Drone Maker India.evidence: Dronemaker India is an active drone component manufacturer founded in 2020 and headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, operating via its website dronemaker.co.in. This information is sourced from the company website and LinkedIn registry data.

Karman Drones Private Limited.event: renamed to KD Aerospace Systems Private Limited
Karman Drones Private Limited.evidence: The company was incorporated in 2021 in Noida and later renamed to KD Aerospace Systems Private Limited as verified by Ministry of Corporate Affairs registries and its company website. It develops multirotor UAVs and ground control systems for the drone robotics market.
